rationale: Operator chose a (2026-11-27, full rubric). Problem: update(id, editFn) hides the operation, so a remote server cannot authorize or audit by kind; shape B names it (async write/create, reads stay sync) with the six enterprise conditions and the optional concurrency token. Counter-argument: additive (b) avoids breaking 0.45.0; a survives because b keeps two code paths per operation and the files backend would never exercise the async path. Check: no consumer besides ai-sdlc-enterprise imports @ai-sdlc/pipeline-cli/knowledge (unchecked). Undefined, specified in tasks AISDLC-1455-1457: kind set, status values, token type, write/create log events; AISDLC-1432 (DEC-0428 factory) lands first. Provisional: Product (Kline) review of the RFC-0053 amendment (AISDLC-1458); Design (Morgan) pending on RFC-0053; enterprise RFC-0002 signers.
